title: A Implementation node record
description: An Implementation node record. The two digests separate intent from execution: a changed apiHash asks whether the thing still satisfies its requirement, a changed bodyHash asks whether it needs running again. Each digest carries its own source location (SEG-SREQ-050) — per hash, not per node, because the two spans of one function differ by locator even where repository and path coincide.

id.description: An absolute IRI minted at serialization time. Opaque: its parts are never split back out, because a part may itself contain the separator (ADR-0007).

seg:localId.description: The case-local stable identifier — the string that enters a hash preimage. The id above is its serialization, not a second identity.

seg:apiHashSource.description: Where the content behind seg:apiHash lives (SEG-SREQ-050). A reference for transient fetch, never integrity data: no part of a source location enters a hash preimage.

seg:sourceLocator.description: How the hashed span is found within the file. 'symbol:<path>#api' names the symbol whose api span the digest covers; the span boundary itself is the extractor's parser-independent rule, deliberately not recorded here, so unrelated edits above the symbol change nothing. 'file' says the digest covers the whole file.

seg:bodyHashSource.description: Where the content behind seg:bodyHash lives (SEG-SREQ-050). A reference for transient fetch, never integrity data: no part of a source location enters a hash preimage.

seg:sourceLocator.description: How the hashed span is found within the file. 'symbol:<path>#body' names the symbol whose body span the digest covers; the span boundary itself is the extractor's parser-independent rule, deliberately not recorded here. 'file' says the digest covers the whole file.

seg:extractedFrom.description: The revision of each repository at which the content behind the digests was read (ADR-0016). Each key is a repository name that the content anchors name. Each value is a revision: 40 or 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. A producer-recorded claim, never a hash preimage member. The field is optional, and a record that has no extraction revision carries no field.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest, lowercase hex, exactly 64 characters. SHA-256 is fixed for the whole graph, so the digest needs no algorithm beside it (ADR-0005).

sourceRepo.description: The repository holding the content this digest covers.

sourcePath.description: The path within the repository to the file holding the content.
